title: Agent Loop Stepper
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Step through the five phases of one agent turn, then choose what the harness does next in six situations.

educational.topic: The Agent Loop, Tools, and Context
learningObjectives: The learner will explain what the harness does after each of 6 model replies or tool results by choosing the outcome of each, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Situation 3 and situation 1 both contain a tool call. State the one difference that makes the harness act on one and not the other.
commonMisconceptions: The model runs its own tools.
A tool call written as text still runs.
The conversation is reset each turn.
A permission question is answered automatically.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.

chapter_title: The Agent Loop, Tools, and Context
